# MediaPipe Tasks Vision + Hand Landmarker

Google, Apache-2.0. Runtime @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.2.0 copied from the existing Sorijeum artworks local bundle. Model hand_landmarker.task copied unchanged from that project. Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe . No remote inference. A dedicated worker uses CPU inference and returns two hands with 21 landmarks each.
